mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bt_knowledge_base WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} ) AS knowledgeCount, (SELECT count(distinct bd.document_id) from bt_document bd LEFT JOIN bt_knowledge_base kb on kb.knowledge_id = bd.knowledge_id WHERE bd.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND kb.tenant_id = bd.tenant_id AND kb.status_cd ='00A' AND bd.status_cd = '00A' ) AS documentCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.qa_id) FROM bt_dc_qa_record a LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = a.creator_id LEFT JOIN bt_tenant_user tu ON tu.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND u.status_cd = '00A' AND tu.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND tu.tenant_id = a.tenant_id ) AS userAskCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) FROM bt_document bd LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document_contributor c ON c.document_id = bd.dc_document_id LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE bd.status_cd = '00A' AND c.status_cd = '00A' AND u.status_cd = '00A' AND bd.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} ) AS documentContributorCount

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bt_dc_document_contributor c LEFT JOIN bt_document bd ON bd.dc_document_id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN bt_tenant_user tu ON tu.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.status_cd = '00A' AND u.status_cd = '00A' AND tu.status_cd = '00A' AND bd.status_cd = '00A' AND bd.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.tenant_id = c.tenant_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bt_dc_qa_record a LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = a.creator_id LEFT JOIN bt_tenant_user tu ON tu.user_id = u.user_id AND tu.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status_cd = '00A' AND tu.status_cd = '00A'

SELECT u.user_id, u.real_name, u.user_icon, COALESCE(doc_s.upload_count, 0) AS uploadCount, COALESCE(fb_s.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(fb_s.dislike_count, 0) AS dislikeCount, COALESCE(ref_s.ref_count, 0) AS referenceCount, (COALESCE(doc_s.upload_count, 0) + COALESCE(fb_s.like_count, 0) - COALESCE(fb_s.dislike_count, 0) + COALESCE(ref_s.ref_count, 0)) AS comprehensiveScore FROM ( SELECT tu.user_id FROM bt_tenant_user tu WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND tu.status_cd = '00A' ) tu JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = tu.user_id AND u.status_cd = '00A'
AND u.real_name LIKE
#{query.searchContent}
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.user_id AS creator_id, COUNT(bd.document_id) AS upload_count FROM bt_dc_document_contributor c LEFT JOIN bt_document bd ON bd.dc_document_id = c.document_id AND bd.status_cd = '00A' AND bd.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} WHERE c.status_cd = '00A' AND c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} GROUP BY c.user_id ) doc_s ON doc_s.creator_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT doc_owner.creator_id, SUM(CASE WHEN qa.user_feedback = 'LIKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS like_count, SUM(CASE WHEN qa.user_feedback = 'DISLIKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dislike_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ref.qa_id, ref.doc_id FROM bt_dc_qa_chunk_reference ref WHERE ref.status_cd = '00A' AND ref.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} ) ref LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bd.ext_system_id AS doc_id, d.creator_id FROM bt_document bd LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document d ON d.document_id = bd.dc_document_id WHERE bd.status_cd = '00A' AND d.status_cd = '00A' ) doc_owner ON doc_owner.doc_id = ref.doc_id LEFT JOIN bt_dc_qa_record qa ON qa.qa_id = ref.qa_id AND qa.status_cd = '00A' GROUP BY doc_owner.creator_id ) fb_s ON fb_s.creator_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT doc_owner.creator_id, COUNT(*) AS ref_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT qa_id, doc_id FROM bt_dc_qa_chunk_reference WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} ) ref LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bd.ext_system_id AS doc_id, d.creator_id FROM bt_document bd LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document d ON d.document_id = bd.dc_document_id WHERE bd.status_cd = '00A' AND d.status_cd = '00A' ) doc_owner ON doc_owner.doc_id = ref.doc_id GROUP BY doc_owner.creator_id ) ref_s ON ref_s.creator_id = u.user_id ORDER BY comprehensiveScore DESC
